title: TDMA 250 ms slot cannot contain the profile own SF10 airtime and guard is contradictory
description: Correctness review: spec/09-packets-timing.md:630-632 says slot duration is airtime+50ms guard and gives SF10/125kHz approximately 250ms. packets-timing.json airtime vectors show even 17 bytes takes 329.727ms and a 77-byte link packet takes 821.248ms, yet tdma_slot_constants at lines 860-864 fixes slot_ms=250 and guard_ms=50. The FSM table at spec line 671 separately says Guard 100ms. A 250ms slot necessarily overlaps for the stated PHY/frame examples. Define one guard and derive/configure slot length from the maximum permitted airtime for its DR, then regenerate vectors.
